entry.name: Google AI Essentials
entry.note: A course certificate, not a proctored exam; a non-technical introduction to using generative AI at work
entry.audience: Anyone in a non-technical role who wants working fluency with generative AI

covers: Using generative AI tools for ideas and content
Using AI responsibly and identifying biases
Developing strategies to stay up-to-date in AI
Explaining how AI functions at a basic level
Describing capabilities and limitations of AI tools
Recognizing the importance of human oversight
Applying prompting techniques like few-shot prompting
reading.format: Self-paced online program with hands-on activities; under 10 hours; 17 languages available.
reading.summary: Google AI Essentials is a self-paced program taught by Google AI experts. It teaches how to use generative AI tools to speed up daily tasks, generate ideas and content, write effective prompts, and use AI responsibly. Completing the program earns a certificate from Google that can be shared with employers and networks.
reading.audience: People across roles and industries who are new to AI and want to increase productivity. No programming skills are needed.
